question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}\},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 7 \\ 3\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 7 \\ 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The equation above gives the system with the augmented matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & -9 \\ -1 & 2 & 7 \\ 1 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the matrix using Gaussian elimination, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & -9 \\ -1 & 2 & 7 \\ 1 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 3 \\ -1 & 2 & 7 \\ 2 & -3 & -9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & 10 \\ 2 & -3 & -9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & 10 \\ 0 & -3 & -15\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+\frac{3}{2}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & 10 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}=3 \\ 2{x}_{2}=10.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get ${x}_{2}=5.$ 

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 5\end{aligned}].$

Finally, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=3+5=8.$
